what: The output of one real first preview, exactly as it arrived through the pseudo-terminal Plantoir runs preview.sh in: CRLF line endings, colour codes and spinner redraws included, because they are the point. Captured 2026-09-20 on a scratch rehearsal folder (ICS4U, section 1, the website builder rebuilt first), not a teacher's folder. The one personal path in it has been replaced with /Users/person/Desktop/Class Websites; nothing else has been changed. Used by ScriptRunnerPreviewAnnouncementTests (GitHub #235).
whyItMatters: The address is announced early and about 11,000 more characters follow, so an 8,000-character tail read of this output has lost the address by the time Quartz says its server started.
